refinement_rule: only refine the locked winner's alpha neighborhood
matched_pair_estimand: whole standalone discrete-coordinate DSEL plus R08C10 package versus legacy at identical alpha; not direction selection alone
matched_pair_command_audit: exact after removing run label and registered DSEL package options
reparameterization_choice_reason: existing production precision policy; a single policy avoids an outer-algorithm switch and protects the low-I_perp mesh
eligible_record_definition: single-run adaptation of protocol-native complete_candidate_calls: the initial evaluated state plus reparam_committed states only
formal_selection_rule: I_perp cost-to-precision Pareto comparison on eligible complete projected states, then require segment_length_cv <= 0.0065 and segment_length_ratio <= 1.03
cost_to_precision_definition: C(tau) is the minimum actual optimization NF among eligible records with I_perp <= tau; no interpolation; unreachable is infinity

full_curve_dominance_test.comparators: same-alpha matched legacy control and, separately, official Stage-IV v4
full_curve_dominance_test.thresholds: every eligible Pareto-record I_perp threshold of the comparator
full_curve_dominance_test.weak_condition: candidate C(tau) <= comparator C(tau) at every threshold
full_curve_dominance_test.strict_condition: strict inequality at at least one threshold
full_curve_dominance_test.tightest_precision_condition: candidate must reach I_perp no larger than comparator's tightest eligible reachable precision

coarse_grid_failure_rule: if no coarse alpha dominates, refine alpha only around the best I_perp cost-to-precision near-miss; every other flag remains frozen
densified_energy_barrier_role: embargoed until alpha is locked, then post-lock validation of the selected finalist only
